title: I want more!
text: I want more!. Its very cute and is exactly what I wanted. Its even bigger than expected but folds up completely flat. Its made well and the canvas is heavy duty but not scratchy. Ordered Friday afternoon. Received the next day. Thank you Amazon Prime. Update three weeks later. still looks like new and has held up with a lot of heavy items like 4 2 litter bottles of coke. The only problem I had was an easy fix. The material around the zipper kept raveling. If it continued, the zipper would have come undone. I corrected that by super gluing the edge of fabric around zipper. Or you could sew a loop stitch instead.
